'''Scott Koehler''' (also published as '''Scott Boehler''') is a Kentucky Star Wars CCG player who finished 2nd–3rd at [[December 2000 Lexington tournament]] on 2 December 2000, according to Matt Baker's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1522">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-10-lexington-ky-12-2-00d1522/ lexington-ky-12-2-00], DeckTech (Matt "kjerg" Baker, 10 December 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-10-lexington-ky-12-2-00d1522/ GitHub Pages].</ref> He played at the [[2000 North American Continental Championship]] on 11 August 2000 with EBO, according to Yannick Lapointe's tournament report, which spells him "Scott Boehler(sp?)".<ref name="tr-d1134">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-16-gencon-2k-who-s-your-daddyd1134/ gencon-2k-who-s-your-daddy], DeckTech (Yannick "Crusher" Lapointe, 16 August 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-16-gencon-2k-who-s-your-daddyd1134/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
